description_en: Retrieves the download URL of a sound code audio file
description_zh: 调用该接口获取声码音频下载地址
name: GetSoundCodeAudio

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If the public instance does not have an ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of unique identifiers of sound codes. A maximum of 100 elements can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 声码的唯一标识列表，最多100个元素
parameters.name: sound_code_list
